data.name: Variant Channeling - Disease
data.description: Heal - Creatures heal %1 points of ability damage to one ability score (your choice). Harm - Creatures are sickened until the end of your next turn, plus %1 rounds. At cleric level 10, you may select one creature as the target of a contagion in addition to the effects of the channeled energy. At cleric level 20, all creatures in the area are subject to contagion in addition to the effects of the channeled energy.|ChannelModifier
